author: _LionRT_
body:
Hi! I'm León, my nick on minecraft is _LionRT_ and I want to appeal my infraction. I was banned 4 months ago for "Hacking - Click Aimbot". When I was banned I was realy sad and I left Minecraft for 4 months now I want to continue playing minecraft in Avicus because I really like the comunity. I think you have to appeal my infraction because I never used any type of hacks and I don't a gaming mouse, obviusly I don't have macros so I think I should be unbanned.

Thanks for your time, León.
